title: Precision Lithography
description: Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

puzzle.goal: Monochromatic light of wavenumber k passes through a slit of width a in a mask and is collected at angle θ. Add up the wavelets from every point x across the opening, each with the phase delay its path picks up, to get the far-field amplitude.
puzzle.name: Fraunhofer slit diffraction (Rayleigh resolution of a lithography lens)
puzzle.form: int ( - a / 2 , a / 2 , exp ( - i * k * x * sin ( θ ) ) , x )
puzzle.ask: The integral gives U = a·sin β/β with β = ka·sinθ/2, which first vanishes at sin θ = λ/a. A lens of numerical aperture NA collects sin θ ≤ NA, so the finest printable feature is CD = k1·λ/NA. Find CD (nm) for the immersion scanner below.
puzzle.method: Each point of the opening is a source; its wavelet arrives with phase k·x·sinθ relative to the centre. Integrate the phase factor across the opening, then find the first zero of the result.
